Best Ball, Ep. 2: Our Epic Ireland Golf Trip The 2026 Texas Children's Houston Open final leaderboard is headed by winner Gary Woodland, who earned the PGA Tour win in the event at Memorial Park Golf Course in Houston, Texas. Woodland won the tournament for his first PGA Tour win in nearly seven years, taking the title by five shots over Nicolai Hojgaard on 21-under 259. Johnny Keefer, last season's No. 1 player on the Korn Ferry Tour, finished in a tie for third place with defending champion Min Woo Lee after a closing 64 got him to 15-under total. Sam Stevens finished alone in fifth place on 14-under total. Woodland won the $1,782,000 winner's share of the $9,900,000 purse. Texas Children's Houston Open recap notes Woodland earned 48 Official World Golf Ranking points with the win in the 72-hole stroke-play championship, which helps his place in the world ranking.
